operative-live-awareness.scope: Full native 156 request starts at 4844. PacketLog 4875–4876 adds stat 204 +15 for 300 s with 15 s own reuse. The same ordinary Sneak approach then reveals at SA 28 versus baseline 13.

stealth-detection.source: The shipped 156 active modifier is stat 204 at caster-level scale 0.3 for 300 seconds.
